name: Givin
description: Givins were a sentient species from Yag'Dhul. They had the appearance of an animated skeleton, and were renowned for their mathematical genius. During the Galactic Civil War, the Givin cryptographer Drusil Bephorin was recruited into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

data.name: Givin
data.distinctions: Skeletal appearance, able to survive in a vacuum for short periods
